chunks: And by this chain of narration, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who said: Muhammad ibn Ali informed me, who said: Al-Abbas ibn Abd Allah narrated to us from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mas'ud, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: The most beloved of my Ahl al-Bayt to me and the best [person] I leave behind after me is Ali ibn Abi Talib.

key_terms.أَحَبُّ: Most beloved — superlative of hubb (love), indicating the highest degree of the Prophet's personal affection
key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: Best/most excellent — superlative of fadl (virtue/excellence), indicating spiritual and moral superiority
key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتِي: My Ahl al-Bayt — the Prophet's household, a theologically significant term in Islamic tradition referring to those whose love is mandated in the Quran

ai.seo_question: Which member of the Prophet's family did the Prophet Muhammad love most?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) explicitly naming Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) as both the most beloved of his Ahl al-Bayt to him personally and the best person he leaves behind after his death. The statement was transmitted through Imam Ali himself, who witnessed and preserved these words of the Prophet. This tradition is significant in the Shia tradition as direct prophetic testimony to Ali's preeminence among the household of the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali informed me. He said: Al-`Abbas b. `Abdullah narrated to us from `Abd al-Rahman b. Al-Aswad from `Abd al-Rahman b. Mas`ud from `Ali (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: The most beloved of my Ahl al-Bayt to me and the best [person] I leave behind is `Ali b. Abi Talib.
